content: {"episode_id":"ep-05057","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, for episode ep-05057. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1), occurring against a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10). Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances in an outpatient setting. We request reconsideration of the denial, which was based solely on precertification not being obtained before services were rendered, and ask that the documented medical necessity for CPT 93229 be reviewed."}
